Reads the color of a pixel of a locked buffer in the same form as [ReadPixel64](ReadPixel64). The buffer has to be locked with [LockBuffer](LockBuffer). This is a BlitzLLVM extension.

```blitzbasic
Graphics3D 320, 240, 64, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
LockBuffer
WritePixelFast64 5, 5, 0, 0.5, 0.25, 2.0, 1.0
Local r:Float16, g:Float16, b:Float16, a:Float16
Local c:Long = ReadPixelFast64(5, 5, 0, r, g, b, a)
UnlockBuffer
Print "blue " + b
WaitKey
```
@param x       Horizontal position of the pixel.
@param y       Vertical position of the pixel.
@param buffer  The locked buffer to read from. Defaults to the current buffer.
@param red     Variable of type Float16 that gets the red of the pixel, from 0 to 1. Can be left out.
@param green   Variable of type Float16 that gets the green of the pixel, from 0 to 1. Can be left out.
@param blue    Variable of type Float16 that gets the blue of the pixel, from 0 to 1. Can be left out.
@param alpha   Variable of type Float16 that gets the alpha of the pixel, from 0 to 1. Can be left out.
@returns The pixel as the buffer stores it, 8 bytes with the first byte in the lowest bits (for the depth 64 that is the red, green, blue and alpha half floats), or 0 if the position is outside of the buffer.
@gap A buffer that is not locked is ignored by a build without `-d` (a read gives 0), and stops a debug build (`-d`) with an error message.
